title: Static trust lists
description: Restates HCERT Specification, Appendix A - Trust Management; RFC 7517 JSON Web Key. HCERT Specification, Appendix A - Trust Management: “the file format of this trusted list may vary, e.g., it can be a signed JWKS”.

statements.label: Static trust lists
statements.requirement: The trust store SHALL load DSCs from PEM and DER, for tests, pinned bilateral or national lists, and fully offline deployments.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-TRU-005 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-TRU-005 a static list of PEM certificates loads` (TrustListTest.kt)).
